Replace mode can corrupt files

Replace mode writes the conversion result straucht back tae the oreeginal files; ance owerwritten, the oreeginals cannae be fund again.

• Gin the app is interruptit, the storage rins oot, or the permeession is taen back while writin, the soorce files may be corruptit
• Nae conversion is guaranteed tae succeed, an on failure the soorce files may already be uiseable nae mair
• Try ane or twae files first tae mak shuir awthing is fine afore processin in bulk
• Mak yer ain backup o important photos first

This feature is gien "as is"; ye uise it at yer ain risk, an the author is no liable fur corruptit or tint files.
